title: 🚂 Loco change & Skip stations! (v1.7.0)
message: Change your engine at a stop, run through stations without stopping, and many fixes you asked for!
points: 🔄 NEW: Loco change — at any stop, uncouple your engine, park it in the siding, then drive your new engine (1 or 2 locos) onto the train. Electric to diesel, or anything you like!
↩️ Loco change with REV: the new engine couples at the other end — no run-round needed.
🔁 What you pick is what you get: engines and bankers now look exactly like their picture. Tap FLIP to turn an engine round.
⏩ NEW: Skip stops — tap SKIP and your train runs through that station on the main line, green signals all the way, like a real Duronto.
🚉 At skipped stations, other trains may wait for you on another platform — you cross them or overtake them.
🏷️ Smarter train names: passing trains now match your route, for example 'Pune – Howrah Duronto' when you drive Pune to Mumbai.
💾 Saved Journeys now show your full route with REV, banker, loco change and skip marks — tap ROUTE to see where you are.
🧭 Saves now keep your direction and your engine after a reversal or loco change.
🚦 Signal fixes: no more red signals that never turn green. If you wait 20 seconds, the station master lets you pass and tells you why you were stopped.
🏆 Activities support loco change and skip stops too, with clear limits shown while you build.
📋 Cleaner stop rows: all options (PF, REV, Banker, Loco, Skip) sit neatly below the station name, and the whole journey list scrolls.
💾 Your old saved journeys and activities still work.
✨ Many small fixes and improvements.

title: ⏰ Choose your time speed! (v1.6.0)
message: You told us day and night change too fast — now you decide how fast time moves in your journey!
points: ⏰ NEW: Time speed — open Journey settings, turn on Live weather & time, and choose how fast the clock runs.
🚆 7 speeds: Real Time, Relaxed, Standard, Accelerated, Fast Forward, Time Warp and Instant.
⭐ Standard is the new default — a full day lasts about 1.5 hours, much slower than before.
🕐 Real Time: 1 second in the game is 1 real second, so a full day takes 24 hours.
🌙 Each speed shows how long a full day lasts, so you know when night will come.
📌 Turn Live weather & time OFF and the time of day you picked stays fixed for the whole journey.
🏆 Works in Activities too. Shared activities keep the same time speed for your friends.
💾 Your old saved journeys and activities still work — they use the Standard speed.
✨ Smoother game, plus small fixes and improvements.

title: 🚂 48 new loco horns! (v1.5.0)
message: Your train now sounds like the real thing! We added 48 new loco horns, and every engine blows its own horn.
points: 🚂 NEW: 48 loco horns — electric engines, diesel engines and trainsets each have their own horn sound.
🎺 Hold the HORN button and the horn keeps blowing smoothly for as long as you hold it. Let go and it ends naturally, just like a real horn.
🎛️ NEW: Horn selector — tap the tune button next to HORN, swipe left or right, and pick any of the 48 horns. Choose AUTO to always use your engine's own horn.
🎮 The game keeps running while you choose your horn — no pause needed.
🚆 Passing trains now blow their own engine's horn when they cross or overtake you.
✨ Smoother game, plus small fixes and improvements.

title: 💾 Save anywhere — never lose your progress! (v1.4.0)
message: You told us long journeys were going back to the start after saving. We fixed it! Now your save remembers exactly where you are.
points: 💾 NEW: Save anywhere — on the line, on a bridge, in a tunnel or in a loop. Your journey continues from exactly that spot.
🚩 NEW: Checkpoint station — when you save between stations, a small Checkpoint station is made at that place. You start there next time, with the guard's whistle and a green signal.
🚉 Near a station? If you save just before or just after a station, you continue from that station.
🛤️ Everything stays the same — your route, platforms, speed limits, banker engines, crossings, overtakes and train are kept just as you set them.
📋 Before saving you can see where your journey will continue. The Saved page shows your Checkpoints with a 💾 sign.
🔁 Saved before this update? Continue it once and save again — from then on it remembers your exact place.
✨ Smoother game, plus small fixes and improvements.

title: 💾 Save your journey & so much more! (v1.3.0)
message: Thank you for all your reviews and ideas — this update is full of features you asked for!
points: 🛠️ Fixed: touching the edge of the screen no longer closes your journey. A back swipe now simply pauses the game.
💾 NEW: Save & Exit — long route? Tap Pause → SAVE & EXIT and continue later from the station you last left.
🔖 NEW: Saved page — tap SAVED on the home screen to see all your saved journeys and activities. Rename or delete them any time.
🚉 NEW: Choose your platform — pick PF 1 to 5 at the start, at every stop and at the destination.
🔧 NEW: Choose your yard shunter — pick a different engine for the start yard and the end yard.
🔢 NEW: Your own train number — give your train a 5-digit number in the Train Builder. You'll hear it in the station announcements!
🚦 Activities: crossing and overtaking trains can have their own train number too.
🗑️ NEW: CLEAR TRAIN — empty the whole train in one tap in the Train Builder.
✨ Smoother game, plus many small fixes and improvements.

title: 🚆 Short journeys are here! (v1.2.0)
message: We read every review — thank you! Many of you asked for shorter distances, so here they are.
points: 📏 You asked, we listened: the minimum distance between stations is now just 2 km (it was 10 km). Quick 2–3 minute runs are now possible!
⏱️ NEW: Custom journey length — choose any time from 5 to 300 minutes.
🛤️ Loop stations fit nicely on short routes. Each extra loop just needs 1 km more.
ⓘ NEW: Tap the ⓘ button in the route preview to see the simple distance rules.
📤 Share your activities as a file — send them to friends on WhatsApp and play each other's routes.
🎨 A fresh new Import screen and a cleaner route preview.
✨ Smoother game, plus many small fixes and improvements.

title: 💎 Premium is here! (v1.1.0)
message: A big update with Premium, update alerts and a smoother game. Thank you for driving with us!
points: 💎 NEW: Premium — pay once, keep it forever. No ads ever, every train and every feature unlocked.
🎁 Scratch the secret card on the Premium page to reveal a special 1-hour price!
🔔 Update alerts — you'll now see what's new in every version right here.
🎮 More games by DevDuo — tap the new button on the home screen to find our other train games.
✨ Smoother driving, faster menus and better performance.
🛠️ Many small fixes and improvements.

title: 🚆 Welcome to Train Driver India! (v1.0.0)
message: Drive trains across India — plan your route, build your train and handle every part of the job.
points: 🗺️ Plan any route with stops, loco reversal and banker engines
🚦 Real Indian signals — red, yellow, double yellow and green
🔀 Crossings and overtakes at loop stations
📢 Station announcements in English, Hindi and your language
🌄 10+ landscapes, live weather, day and night
